analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance is maintained for the third consecutive trading day. RSI at 48.8 is positioned at the lower end of the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram at -0.0101 shows slowing improvement, hinting at a potential shift towards weakness. The weekly ADX at 27.5 indicates a persistent trend, but the daily chart lacks clear directional conviction. The 52-week position at 23.9% shows an increase from the low, but remains significantly below the 52-week high.
